error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device.
error.device_not_found: Device not found. Make sure it is powered on and in range.

user.title: Select a Surplife BLE light
user.description: Choose a discovered device from the list, or select manual entry.

manual.title: Add a Surplife BLE light manually
manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth address (MAC or UUID) of your device. You can find it with a BLE scanner app or the ble-rgb scan command.

init.title: Surplife BLE options
init.description: Configure how Home Assistant manages the Bluetooth connection to this light.

data_description.disconnect_delay: Seconds to wait after a command before disconnecting to free Bluetooth proxy slots. Set to 0 to keep a persistent connection and poll every 15 seconds.

set_segments.name: Set segment colors
set_segments.description: Give each segment of the lamp its own color. A shorter list is stretched evenly across the segments, so two colors split the lamp in half.

colors.name: Colors
colors.description: List of [red, green, blue] colors, from the first segment to the last.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: Brightness from 1 to 255. Defaults to the current brightness.

set_animation.name: Set animation
set_animation.description: Start one of the lamp's built-in animations with custom speed, density, direction and colors.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: Animation speed from 0 to 100. Defaults to 50, or the running animation's speed.

density.name: Density
density.description: Pattern density from 0 to 100. Defaults to the app's value for the effect.

colors.name: Colors
colors.description: List of up to 16 [red, green, blue] colors. Defaults to a rainbow, or the running animation's colors.

background_color.name: Background color
background_color.description: Color behind the moving pattern. Defaults to black.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: Brightness from 1 to 255. Defaults to the current brightness.
